issue_context.title: Performance regression - Allocation/WorkingSet on PlaintextPlatform
issue_context.body:
Allocations are increasing significantly on PlaintextPlatform, Windows only.
Minimal commits range: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/compare/320f1e1...d47a24c

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1165805/208203552-0a22fb2f-392d-41db-8dcf-7427a0725e7b.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1165805/208203587-7ade7c6e-0a2c-4ac7-b16c-cf845de84d35.png)

This type is the most allocating one after the regression shows up:

```
Name                                                                                               	Inc %	           Inc
 + System.Private.CoreLib.il!System.Threading.DeferredDisposableLifetime`1[System.__Canon].AddRef()	 82.8	   297,039,616
 |+ System.Private.CoreLib.il!ThreadPoolBoundHandle.AllocateNativeOverlapped                       	 82.8	   297,039,616
 | + System.Net.Sockets.il!SocketAsyncEventArgs.DoOperationReceiveSingleBuffer                     	 41.6	   149,219,392
 | + System.Net.Sockets.il!SocketAsyncEventArgs.DoOperationSendSingleBuffer                        	 39.2	   140,601,632
```

@stephentoub
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. If you have write-permissions please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).

Not just Plaintext Platform actually, but most benchmarks that didn't allocate enough to even trigger a GC. All Windows.
